svg.text: The clock starts when either scanner first sees the finding on that asset, not when a ticket is raised; a finding that cannot be fixed in time gets a dated, two-person exception.

svg.text: Each finding takes the highest priority any rule assigns. Low and informational findings wait for the next build refresh. One action, one ticket: a cumulative update closing dozens of CVEs is one change through the rings.

svg.text: compensating control; none expired; sample closed tickets

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Targets in the runbook: P1 100 % within SLA, P2 ≥ 95 %, P3 ≥ 90 %; MTTR P1 ≤ 7 d, P2 ≤ 15 d. Controls: SI-2, SI-2(2), CA-5 (POA&M), RA-5; CISA BOD 22-01 for KEV due dates.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.
